wifiRepair.title: Repair Wi-Fi Connection
wifiRepair.description: This unloads and reloads the Wi-Fi kernel module and restarts NetworkManager. Your network connection will be briefly interrupted.

confirmBranch.title: Install {label}?
confirmBranch.description: This removes any existing NVIDIA driver first, installs {label}, and regenerates the initramfs. A system restart will be required afterwards.

confirmUninstall.title: Uninstall NVIDIA drivers?
confirmUninstall.description: Removes all NVIDIA and CUDA packages, DKMS modules and repository sources. A system restart will be required afterwards.

rocm.description: This adds the official AMD ROCm repository and installs {name}. Requires a ROCm-supported AMD GPU: RDNA2 (RX 6800 and newer), RDNA3 (RX 7700-7900), RDNA4 (RX 9060-9070) or Instinct accelerators — the RX 5000 series and integrated GPUs are not supported. {sizeNote} A session restart will be required afterwards.
rocm.sizeFull: Several GB download — this may take a while.
rocm.removeDescription: This will remove all ROCm packages and the AMD ROCm repository.

hero.title: Security & System Protection
hero.description: Protect your system with backups, firewall, VPN and cleaning tools.

items.timeshift: Creates automatic system snapshots. Protects your configuration and allows easy restoration.
items.grubBtrfs: Automatically add BTRFS snapshots to GRUB menu. Allows booting from snapshots.
items.dejaDup: Simple backups of personal files with encryption support.
items.btrfsAssistant: Advanced management of BTRFS subvolumes and snapshots.
items.gufw: Simple graphical interface for UFW firewall. Control network traffic easily.
items.portmaster: Application-level firewall. Monitor and control network connections per application.
items.protonvpn: Secure and private VPN service from Proton.
items.surfshark: Fast and affordable VPN with unlimited devices.
items.mozillavpn: VPN from Mozilla. Simple, fast and focused on privacy.
items.vpnunlimited: VPN service from KeepSolid with unlimited traffic.
items.cloudflarewarp: Free VPN/DNS service from Cloudflare that secures your connection.
items.nordvpn: Commercial VPN service with servers worldwide (subscription required).
items.bleachbit: Free disk space and maintain privacy. Cleans cache, cookies, and temporary files.
items.stacer: Modern system optimizer with resource monitoring, startup apps, and cache cleaner.
items.sweeper: KDE system cleaner. Simple tool to clean temporary files and browsing history.
items.soplosSysCleaner: Soplos system cleaner. Clean package cache, orphan packages, logs and temporary files.
items.kudu: All-in-one maintenance suite: cache cleaner, malware scanner, performance monitor and app uninstaller.
items.clamtk: Graphical interface for ClamAV. Scan your system against viruses and malware.
items.clamui: Modern Flatpak interface for ClamAV antivirus.
items.rkhunter: Command-line tool to detect rootkits and system threats.
